verdict.rationale: Context.dev is documented only as a hosted API, reached through API keys, an MCP endpoint at mcp.context.dev, a CLI and SDKs. Nothing in the pack mentions self-hosted deployment, open-source releases, Docker images or on-prem options. Self-hosting is a fair question for a web-scraping API, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
